mission.title: Our
mission.subtitle: The difference we create with our principles and values

mission.label: Mission
mission.content: To be a trusted bridge in international trade, supporting our customers' growth in global markets by providing the highest quality service. We aim to be a pioneer in the industry with a sustainable trade approach.

vision.label: Vision
vision.content: To become a global trade company serving over 100 countries by 2030, referenced in the industry for its technology-driven solutions. Shaping the future through digital transformation and innovation.

values.label: Values
values.content: Honesty, transparency, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement and environmental responsibility. We manage all our business processes in line with these values and build long-term partnerships.

2010.title: Foundation
2010.description: Global Exim was founded in Turkey with a vision for international trade. We took our first steps and built our foundations.

2015.title: Growth Period
2015.description: We became a strong organization serving 50+ countries. We strengthened our regional leadership.

2020.title: Digital Transformation
2020.description: We launched new services on e-commerce and digital platforms. We invested in technology.

2025.title: Leading Position
2025.description: We are the industry leader operating in 70+ countries. We look to the future with confidence.
